import json, os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
STUB = r'''import json, pathlib, sys, uuid
step, args = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
q = pathlib.Path(step + ".queue"); items = q.read_text().split(); q.write_text(" ".join(items[1:]))
with open("calls.txt", "a") as c: c.write(" ".join([step] + args) + "\n")
def run_exit(**k):
    with open(".tasks/events.jsonl", "a") as e: e.write(json.dumps({"event": "run_exit", "run_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), **k}) + "\n")
def brain(text):
    rid = str(uuid.uuid4()); log = pathlib.Path(".tasks/logs", rid + ".log"); log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    log.write_text(json.dumps({"type": "result", "result": text}) + "\n"); rc = pathlib.Path(".tasks/receipts", rid + ".json"); rc.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    rc.write_text(json.dumps({"provider": "claude", "log_path": str(log.resolve())})); run_exit(role="brain", run_id=rid, receipt=str(rc))
if step == "worker": run_exit(role="worker", seat=args[args.index("--provider") + 1] + "." + args[args.index("--tier") + 1], outcome=items[0])
if step == "probe": sys.exit(items[0] != "ok")
if step == "verify":
    v = pathlib.Path(args[-1], "verification"); v.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (v / (args[args.index("--run-id") + 1] + ".json")).write_text(json.dumps({"work_unit": "x", "result": items[0]})); sys.exit(items[0] != "pass")
if step == "review": brain(json.dumps({"run_ids": [], "commits": [{"commit": "c", "verdict": items[0], "evidence": ["e"]}], "findings": [], "verdict": items[0]}))
if step == "plan": F = chr(96) * 4; brain("".join(F + "\n---\ntask_id: %s\nfeature: F001\n---\n# Task\n" % t + F + "\n" for t in items[0].split(",")))
'''
def go(**queues):
    d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); m = d / "docs/missions/m"; (m / "tasks").mkdir(parents=True)
    for sub in ("scripts", "schemas"): shutil.copytree(sub, d / sub, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__"))
    (m / "GOAL.md").write_text("# m\n"); (m / "tasks/T-001.md").write_text("---\ntask_id: T-001\nfeature: F001\n---\n# Task\n")
    (m / "features.json").write_text(json.dumps({"run_order": ["F001"], "features": [{"id": "F001", "passes": False}, {"id": "F012", "passes": False}]}))
    (m / "fleet.json").write_text(json.dumps({"seats": {s: {} for s in ("agy.economy", "claude.economy", "codex.economy", "codex.premium", "cursor.economy")}}))
    (d / ".gitignore").write_text(".tasks/\ncalls.txt\n*.queue\nstub.py\n__pycache__/\n"); (d / "stub.py").write_text(STUB)
    for k, v in queues.items(): (d / f"{k}.queue").write_text(v)
    g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(d), "-c", "user.name=o", "-c", "user.email=o@o", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    g("init", "-q"); g("add", "-A"); g("commit", "-qm", "base")
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("CLAUDE", "PURRFECT_", "MISSION_RUN_"))}
    env.update(PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1", GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="o", GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="o@o", GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="o", GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="o@o")
    env.update({f"MISSION_RUN_{s.upper()}": f"python3 {d}/stub.py {s}" for s in ("worker", "verify", "review", "plan", "probe")})
    r = subprocess.run(["bash", "scripts/mission-run.sh", "docs/missions/m", "--provider", "codex"], cwd=d, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    ev = [json.loads(l) for l in (d / ".tasks/events.jsonl").read_text().splitlines() if '"run_exit"' not in l]
    return d, r, [tuple(str(e.get(k)) for k in ("event", "task", "seat", "from", "to", "round", "result", "verdict", "tasks", "detail") if k in e) for e in ev], g
d, r, ev, g = go(worker="launch_failed launch_failed completed", probe="broken broken", verify="pass", review="PASS")
assert r.returncode == 3, (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
assert ev == [("probe", "T-001", "codex.economy", "broken"), ("reroute", "T-001", "codex.economy", "agy.economy"), ("probe", "T-001", "agy.economy", "broken"),
              ("reroute", "T-001", "agy.economy", "cursor.economy"), ("verify", "T-001", "1", "pass"), ("review", "T-001", "1", "PASS"),
              ("decision_needed", "F001: every task passed; accept it")], ev
calls = (d / "calls.txt").read_text().splitlines()
assert "probe codex.economy --fleet docs/missions/m/fleet.json" in calls and [c.split()[c.split().index("--provider") + 1] for c in calls if c.startswith("worker")] == ["codex", "agy", "cursor"], calls
d, r, ev, g = go(worker="completed " * 4, verify="pass pass fail fail", review="FAIL FAIL", plan="T-002")
assert r.returncode == 3, (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
assert ev == [("verify", "T-001", "1", "pass"), ("review", "T-001", "1", "FAIL"), ("verify", "T-001", "2", "pass"), ("review", "T-001", "2", "FAIL"),
              ("decomposition_miss", "T-001", "T-002"), ("verify", "T-002", "1", "fail"), ("verify", "T-002", "2", "fail"),
              ("decision_needed", "T-002: split from T-001, 2 rounds without a pass")], ev
assert (d / "docs/missions/m/tasks/T-002.md").read_text().split("\n")[1] == "split_from: T-001" and g("status", "--porcelain") == ""
req = (d / ".tasks/requests/T-001-split.md").read_text()
assert "docs/missions/m/tasks/T-001.md" in req and "round 2" in req and "docs/missions/m/verification/" in req and '"verdict": "FAIL"' in req, req
assert (d / "calls.txt").read_text().splitlines()[6] == "plan docs/missions/m plan --request .tasks/requests/T-001-split.md", (d / "calls.txt").read_text()
print("ok")
